metadata.description: One bench, three judges: Ward rules on the act, Keel on the sequence, Makoto on the statement.

plugins.name: ward
plugins.description: Judges the pending act: 11 exact, no-substitute PreToolUse hard denies for actions dangerous regardless of intent or honesty.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Judges the sequence: denies a costly call until the cheap call that licenses it is on record, and names the construction that retires the guard for good. One obligation ledger reconciled at Stop; exact predicates over event plus ledger, never over prose. Fixes: walk_tree honours the ignore files of the repositories it walks (Courthouse #34); a creation is not an unread rewrite (Courthouse #36); C08-check-can-fail's checker-key extraction no longer keys an obligation on a shell keyword or output filter (Courthouse #40).

plugins.name: makoto
plugins.description: Judges the statement: holds Claude Code to its word — every claim checked against the agent's own logged record; faked checks blocked, not warned (four narrow advisory self-checks excepted). Two-tier catalog (15 pre-checks, 21 Stop gates); blocking checks certified at zero false positives on the shipped corpus and gold negative sets — per-gate certification basis in the Makoto README.

plugins.name: courthouse-demo
plugins.description: Bench tooling, not a judge: switch demo mode on and see what Ward, Keel and Makoto are actually DOING -- every deny, block and fault, read from the records they already write. It rules on nothing and changes no verdict.
